title: CodeQuest — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Foundry Specimen & Type Case. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Foundry Specimen & Type Case
options.lineage: letterpress type cases and foundry specimen sheets
options.thesis: CodeQuest is a classified system: every mission, skill, record and alert is a sort in a labelled compartment, and each screen is the specimen sheet that shows what the set can say.
options.viewport: The student Dashboard as one specimen sheet: a foundry title stamped with its optical size, the current directive in the sheet's widest compartment, missions as a specimen list, a type-case column of learning records.
options.risk: A compartment grid is one nudge away from being ornament — if the codes carry no meaning the sheet is only boxes. It also lands far from a dark terminal world.

raised.raise: Committed colour owns whole regions: each work-area family fills its region with one flat, unmodulated colour, so the shell reads as blocks before any text is parsed.
Running time is a first-class number: every lesson, mission and challenge carries its expected minutes in tabular figures, right-aligned in its column, never folded into prose.
Proof beside the number: every headline figure is one click from the record behind it, so nothing on the screen is unbacked.

options.label: The Mark-Sense Sheet
options.lineage: optical mark-recognition exam papers and mark-recognition ballots
options.thesis: CodeQuest is graded by a machine that believes only ink, so every screen behaves like a sheet you scan for marks.
options.viewport: The Dashboard as one scanned form: a heavy black instruction band naming the directive, one mark row per course section with fills and blank cells, a signature strip carrying XP and the next mission.
options.risk: Also where most runs in this category land, and mark-sense paper reads as drudgery unless the hierarchy is ruthless.

options.label: The Star Atlas Plates
options.thesis: A course is a plate: competencies are magnitudes, and a class is a field you scan for the dots that have moved.
options.viewport: The teacher's attention queue as a plate: one dot per learner sized by stalled days, ringed red when a deadline has passed, over a ruled coordinate field.
options.case: Holds audience identification: students and teachers both read charts, and finding the outlier is exactly the teacher's job. Loses product clarity — a coordinate field is ornament on a working screen.
options.risk: Rides close to the dark register the fresh round was meant to leave, and dot plots hide the row-level detail a teacher must act on.

options.label: The Cast Catalogue
options.thesis: Every learner is a cast number, and state speaks in code that decodes only when you ask.
options.viewport: The admin console as a catalogue: cast numbers down the index, each record a pulse plot with a colour strip that decodes to text on hover.
options.case: Holds product clarity: nothing labelled twice, strict sequence, index as the only map is superb working discipline. Loses audience identification — it lives in design culture, not in the learner's work.
options.risk: Near-black ground puts it beside the incumbent it was meant to replace, and a code that only experts can read is a wall to the teacher.

options.label: The Concourse Board
options.thesis: Attention is a departure board: live rows ranked by time, columns that never move, and state that restyles without breaking the grid.
options.viewport: The teacher's Needs Attention queue as a board: learners as rows ranked by stalled days, columns locked, delay and overdue restyling the row in place.
options.case: Holds audience identification: a glanceable ranked board is the teacher's real job. Loses the student's half — a mission list as departures is a costume, and the cascade would trespass on the calm Challenge workspace.
options.risk: Splits the product into two worlds, one dark and animated for staff and one pale for students.

options.label: The Headland Map
options.thesis: Each course is a swelling lobe of flat colour, and the coastline between lobes does all the dividing.
options.case: Fuses into the Path, but lobes become work areas and the world starts supplying the layout.

options.label: The Folded J-Card
options.thesis: Each course is one side of a tape: tracks ruled in ballpoint, running times tight against the margin.
options.case: Fuses the budget beautifully, but a folding flip topology fights a fixed coding workspace and handwritten caps cannot carry dense records.
options.kept: Running time as a first-class number.

options.label: Monochrome Product Canon
options.lineage: software marketing surfaces built in one neutral scale
options.thesis: Almost no colour, one restrained accent, every claim paired with the interface detail that proves it.
options.case: Defines the floor, not a world — a grey screen with one accent is the category default — and it is already the standing exit below.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably: sidebar, progress rings, lesson cards.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement every course platform uses, at full craft, with nothing distinctive added.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
